system: Ledgerline — multi-tenant invoicing API (fictional; design document only, no code)

scope.selectionCriteria: Every authority-bearing action named in DESIGN.md. Design-doc modality: the control structure is read off the component list and the review notes, so 'full' means every action the document describes — the document itself is the boundary.

sources.note: no codebase exists; all process models are inferred from prose and recorded as assumptions

controlActions.action: issue a session for a member
serve an invoice to a session
serve an invoice by pay-link token
grant a staff member an impersonation session
remove a member from an org

feedback.signal: NONE — no record of who fetched an invoice by token, so scraping is indistinguishable from a customer opening their bill
NONE — the member is never told they were impersonated; the document describes no notification and no audit surface they can read
NONE — no allow-list check or egress log on the org-supplied URL
invoice audit trail — described in the document and assumed present

variables.belief: the orgId in the token is the caller's current org
variables.sourcedFrom: the JWT claim, minted at login and never re-read
variables.staleness: token lifetime — the review notes say removal does not revoke existing sessions, so this is wrong for exactly as long as a token lives

variables.belief: the presenter of a pay-link token is the invoice's customer
variables.sourcedFrom: possession of a UUIDv4 that never rotates
variables.staleness: permanent — the token outlives the payment, the customer relationship, and any dispute

variables.belief: an impersonation session is distinguishable from the member's own session
variables.sourcedFrom: a staff:true claim that downstream services are not documented to read
variables.staleness: the belief is asserted, never checked

variables.belief: the orgId attached by the gateway is authoritative
variables.sourcedFrom: a header set by an upstream component, trusted without re-derivation
variables.staleness: per request, and only as good as PM-1

variables.belief: the email address on an overdue invoice is still the right recipient
variables.sourcedFrom: the invoice row as written at issue time
variables.staleness: unbounded — an invoice can be overdue for months after the contact changed

variables.belief: the configured webhook URL is an external endpoint the org controls
variables.sourcedFrom: a free-text settings field with no validation described
